caption:
Hong Kong home rents hit new highs as competing offers push prices up

Habitat Property's Victoria Allan cites returning expatriates, increased bank hiring and more arrivals from mainland China. Together these factors are tightening housing supply.

Reported by Bloomberg; South China Morning Post; The Straits Times.

Send this to whoever on your team tracks the economy.

headlines: Hong Kong home rents hit new highs as competing offers push prices up
photo_file: DSC02266 Construction Site, Haus der Digitalisierung Montanuniversität Leoben, 2023-08.jpg
photo_alt: A tower crane on a building site under a blue sky
dek: The private home price index dipped, ending two straight months of gains, while rents rose to a record for a 12th straight month.
body: Renewed market volatility and competition from primary home sales weighed on sentiment. The Rating and Valuation Department released the data on Thursday. Prices have risen about 6.5 per cent so far this year.
